feature_blocks.name: hand_xy_image
feature_blocks.semantics: current refined XY / source width,height; zero when invalid

feature_blocks.name: hand_joint_valid
feature_blocks.semantics: current refined joint validity including observed state

feature_blocks.name: hand_proposal_support
feature_blocks.semantics: current DWPose proposal support

feature_blocks.name: hand_presence
feature_blocks.semantics: current finite MediaPipe group-presence value, else zero

feature_blocks.name: hand_presence_valid
feature_blocks.semantics: presence value is finite

feature_blocks.name: hand_observed
feature_blocks.semantics: current refined-hand observed state

feature_blocks.name: hand_proposal_present
feature_blocks.semantics: current proposal/ROI state

feature_blocks.name: hand_roi_image
feature_blocks.semantics: current ROI center x/y and side normalized to source geometry

feature_blocks.name: body_xy_image
feature_blocks.semantics: current body XY / source width,height; zero when invalid

feature_blocks.name: body_support
feature_blocks.semantics: current DWPose body support

feature_blocks.name: body_valid
feature_blocks.semantics: current body-point validity

feature_blocks.name: body_available
feature_blocks.semantics: current complete-body-group availability

feature_blocks.name: dt_seconds
feature_blocks.semantics: actual backward source-timestamp delta, clipped to one second

feature_blocks.name: hand_xy_delta
feature_blocks.semantics: current minus previous normalized refined XY when both valid

feature_blocks.name: hand_delta_valid
feature_blocks.semantics: both current and previous refined joints valid

feature_blocks.name: hand_roi_delta
feature_blocks.semantics: current minus previous normalized ROI when both proposals exist

feature_blocks.name: hand_roi_delta_valid
feature_blocks.semantics: both current and previous hand proposals exist

feature_blocks.name: body_xy_delta
feature_blocks.semantics: current minus previous normalized body XY when both valid

feature_blocks.name: body_delta_valid
feature_blocks.semantics: both current and previous body points valid

feature_blocks.name: hand_observed_transition
feature_blocks.semantics: current minus previous observed state

feature_blocks.name: hand_proposal_transition
feature_blocks.semantics: current minus previous proposal state

limitation: Feature-space translation does not rerun perception or simulate crop/occlusion/physical signer differences.
